source_snapshot.test_name: Upgrade / Downgrade GPUBB firmware by Web when system is booted
source_snapshot.items: Upgrade / Downgrade GPUBB firmware by Web when system is booted
source_snapshot.procedure: With the host system booted, upgrade/downgrade GPUBB firmware through the BMC web UI and perform an AC cycle after flash completion.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek recognizes browser upload, state change and mandatory AC cycle, but treats any user-provided image plus a completion banner/version as sufficient and does not define compatibility, transition directions, activation, recovery or independent GPU health evidence.

original_test_intent.purpose: Validate GPUBB firmware upgrade and downgrade through the platform BMC web UI while the host is booted, including successful image programming, the required post-flash AC cycle, target-version activation and restored GPU/host/BMC health.
original_test_intent.target: The exact GPU baseboard firmware component(s) identified by the platform inventory and approved manifest, not generic BMC, GPU VBIOS, ERoT, MCU or another board firmware target.
original_test_intent.scope: Both source directions—upgrade and downgrade—must be represented as separately approved transitions unless the test owner explicitly defines an ordered two-transition campaign. Each flash completion that requires activation receives exactly its documented AC cycle and post-cycle verification.
original_test_intent.operation: Freeze each current-to-target transition and image hash/signature/compatibility, preserve GPUBB/GPU/BMC/host baselines, quiesce workloads, obtain final flash approval, use the vendor-approved BMC web flow without interruption, wait for authoritative completion, perform the documented controlled AC cycle, then verify active GPUBB version and independent GPU enumeration/diagnostics plus host/BMC recovery before any next direction.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: One approved upgrade transition and one approved downgrade transition, or the exact owner-defined subset/order. The source gives a 30-minute machine-time estimate but no timeout; do not abort or power-cycle solely because the estimate expires.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Each approved image is accepted and programmed without update error, the required AC cycle activates the exact target version, all expected GPUs/baseboard components enumerate and pass the approved health checks, host/BMC/management return normally, and no unexplained SEL/kernel/GPU error remains.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: Platform/component inventory, signed transition manifest and images/hashes/signatures, web session target/image/progress/completion evidence, update task/error logs, exact AC controller/timing/telemetry, pre/post GPUBB/GPU/BMC/host versions, GPU UUID/BDF/topology/diagnostic health, boot/SEL/kernel logs and recovery readiness/outcome for each direction.
ambiguities: The source does not identify GPUBB component instance, current/upgrade/downgrade versions, image format, compatibility or direction order.
`Flashed successfully` does not define activation, all-GPU enumeration, diagnostic or post-AC acceptance.
The AC cycle controller, off time, discharge/ready indicators, allowed count and host/GPU state are unspecified.
The private script path suggests NVIDIA checks but does not establish that it performs or verifies this web firmware workflow.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly identifies every critical missing image, transition, acceptance, AC-cycle and recovery input and prohibits execution now. It conflates current execution prohibition with technical automation capability: the test intent is understandable, and all missing elements are provisionable platform inputs/approvals rather than a permanent semantic or physical impossibility.

applicable_history.decision: The historical review treats the flow as partial browser automation with an image supplied by the user and a mandatory AC cycle, but lacks component/transition/recovery qualification.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Reclassify capability from BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION while keeping execution strictly gated. Approved web automation/read-only verification are technically feasible; image qualification, human authorization and the controlled AC action/recovery remain mandatory.

available_now: The source purpose, execution location, web delivery channel, host-booted condition and post-flash AC requirement are understandable.
Read-only GPUBB/GPU/BMC/host inventory, web capability discovery, log baselines and recovery-path checks can be performed before any upload.

Public NVIDIA documentation confirms firmware web flows are platform/target/package specific and warns that wrong images or interruption can make a platform non-recoverable; its IGX instructions are evidence of risk discipline, not a procedure for this ODM GPUBB.
missing_inputs: Exact GPUBB component/instance and approved current-to-upgrade plus current/upgrade-to-downgrade transition matrix with signed images, hashes, release notes and compatibility
Vendor BMC web-UI procedure/version/session requirements, task-state semantics and authoritative completion/activation indicators
Per-direction GPUBB version, GPU enumeration/topology/diagnostic and host/BMC/SEL acceptance, including rollback expectations
Controlled AC source/operator, off/on timing and readiness indicators, maintenance/workload isolation, explicit approvals, stable power and tested vendor recovery/known-good image
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The platform/GPU firmware owner supplies component/image/transition/acceptance/recovery data; the security/release owner verifies image provenance; workload/system owners approve downtime; the lab power owner controls AC cycling and recovery; the automation owner supplies the qualified browser workflow.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Inventory platform/GPUBB/GPU UUID/BDF/topology, BMC/host firmware and current health through approved interfaces; preserve SEL/kernel/GPU/BMC logs without clearing

Inspect the BMC web UI version/capability and vendor procedure without opening an update action; hash and validate supplied image metadata offline without uploading it; verify OOB/serial/PDU/recovery readiness
prohibited_until_closed: Do not upload/select an image, start update, manipulate AC/PDU/cables, stop services, reset BMC/host/GPU, or accept a browser banner as PASS before every gate is signed

Do not infer compatibility from filename, reuse another platform's public procedure, combine upgrade/downgrade evidence, power-cycle during programming, retry an uncertain write or perform an extra cycle without owner authorization
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: A dry-reviewed run card names every transition/component/image hash, validated web step and task terminal state; two-person checks match image to hardware; workload and stable power are ready; AC timing/controller is rehearsed without DUT impact; recovery/known-good image/OOB access are proven; post-cycle acceptance is independently collectible.

revision_candidate.test_name: Host-Up GPUBB Web Upgrade and Downgrade with AC Activation
revision_candidate.purpose: Validate each approved GPUBB upgrade and downgrade transition through the BMC web UI while the host is booted, then confirm activation and complete GPU/platform recovery after the required controlled AC cycle.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact ODM GPU server/baseboard/BMC release with a qualified GPUBB web-update procedure, signed compatible images, isolated maintenance window, stable controlled AC source, serial/BMC/OOB access and tested recovery.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Every owner-specified GPUBB component instance and both approved version directions. Do not substitute BMC, GPU VBIOS, ERoT, MCU or another firmware target, and do not merge direction-specific evidence.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Component inventory; current/upgrade/downgrade versions and order; signed images/hashes/compatibility/release notes; vendor web steps and task states; credentials/session rules; per-direction activation/diagnostic criteria; AC timing/controller; approvals; stable power; workload quiescence; known-good recovery image/procedure and evidence paths.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: For one approved direction at a time, capture immutable baselines, peer-verify component and image, obtain immediate pre-write approval, perform the documented web upload/update without interruption, wait for the authoritative terminal state, capture evidence, execute exactly the approved AC cycle, verify active target version and independent GPU/host/BMC health, and stop for owner disposition before the next direction.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct platform/component and signed transition selected; image integrity/compatibility verified; host is booted but workloads quiesced; web session and evidence capture qualified; stable AC/PDU and off/on timing approved; console/OOB/recovery/known-good image ready; all logs preserved; two-person final target check complete.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Signed transition manifest and image provenance; pre/post versions and GPUBB/GPU/BMC/host inventory; full web selection/task/progress/completion/error evidence; AC/PDU timestamps/state; GPU UUID/BDF/topology/approved diagnostic results; POST/boot/OS/BMC/SEL/kernel/GPU logs; recovery/final-state record per direction.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The exact platform vendor's GPUBB release manifest, compatibility matrix, BMC web procedure, activation/AC requirements and recovery document for the tested hardware and versions.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Never guess image/target/order, automate past a confirmation gate, interrupt an in-progress write, power-cycle early or extra, retry uncertainty, use another platform's instructions, clear logs or declare PASS from UI completion without active-version and GPU/platform-health proof.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Firmware/release/platform owners approve each transition and image; system/workload owner approves downtime; lab power owner authorizes and controls AC. Immediate confirmation is required after final target/image review before each write and before each AC cycle.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Image release/compatibility judgment, final write authorization, physical or protected PDU AC control and anomaly disposition remain human-controlled. Qualified browser steps, monitoring and read-only evidence collection can be automated within those gates.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On update error, lost session with uncertain task state, power instability, missing target version, GPU enumeration/diagnostic failure or host/BMC recovery failure, do not retry or cycle again; preserve evidence/state, maintain safe power, invoke the exact vendor recovery with authorized known-good image and quarantine the platform until owner disposition.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Any component/image/version ambiguity, failed signature/hash/compatibility, active workload, missing approval/stable power/OOB/recovery, unexpected web warning/task state, interruption risk, update timeout without authoritative status, AC deviation, wrong/missing active version, GPU/host/BMC/SEL error or incomplete direction-specific evidence.

identified_defects: V2 correctly prohibits current execution but incorrectly equates missing provisionable inputs and approval with permanent automation BLOCKED.
DeepSeek does not independently qualify the image/component or prove post-AC activation and GPU health.
The source's generic success criterion and slash-separated directions are insufficient for controlled firmware transitions.
reason_for_change: The firmware intent is clear and a qualified web flow plus automated evidence is technically feasible; the absent images/specification/approval/power/recovery data must block execution now without misclassifying long-term capability.

new_technical_evidence.title: NVIDIA IGX BMC Web User Interface
new_technical_evidence.version: latest page accessed 2026-10-13; IGX-specific and not directly applicable to this ODM GPUBB
new_technical_evidence.applicability: General risk evidence for target-specific BMC web firmware workflows only
new_technical_evidence.supports: NVIDIA web firmware flows require target/platform-specific packages and steps, warn that a wrong image can cause a non-recoverable state and prohibit power cycling during certain updates.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: This source does not define the tested ODM GPUBB component, images, AC timing, success criteria or recovery; the platform vendor procedure remains mandatory.

removed_ambiguities: Separates upgrade and downgrade into traceable approved transitions.
Defines browser completion, activation after AC and independent GPU/platform health as separate evidence gates.
Separates present execution readiness from technical automation capability.
resolved_blockers: Exact intent and workflow class are understandable; missing image, vendor procedure, power contract and recovery are provisionable and therefore do not warrant automation_classification=BLOCKED.
remaining_blockers: Actual upload/write and AC operations remain prohibited until every component/image/transition/acceptance/power/approval/recovery gate is closed.
Any failed or uncertain firmware state blocks retry and the second direction pending owner/vendor disposition.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 retains every V2 safety gate and current no-execution decision while correcting the capability classification, enabling safe pre-work, and defining exactly which human gates surround technically automatable web/evidence stages.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The isolated validator retained every approved GPUBB upgrade/downgrade direction, exact WebUI task, one approved AC activation per transition and full GPU/platform recovery.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: The source requires GPUBB upgrade/downgrade through BMC Web while the host is booted and mandates an AC cycle after flash completion.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 defines the missing firmware and AC safety contract but uses current missing inputs to classify technical capability as BLOCKED.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Allow only read-only inventory/offline qualification before closure; require two-person image/target checks, human write and AC approvals, independent post-AC GPU validation and no automatic retry on uncertainty.
